pageCache.text:
A Warm Welcome
St Simon's mission is to work, learn, pray and play together to fulfil God's unique plan for each and every one of us. At St Simon of England we aim to be a warm and welcoming community where the love of God is shared and our mission statement is lived out every day. We strive for our children to be happy and to learn to the best of their ability as they enjoy a stimulating and wide curriculum and so fulfil their potential in all areas of life. We seek to put our prayers into action seeking opportunities to bring about a love of learning, whilst encouraging pupils to make a positive contribution to the common good and seeking ways to help every child achieve economic well-being. In St Simon of England we strive to achieve our aims and mission by following the teaching of Jesus and upholding our school values.

pageCache.pageTitle: St Simon of England Roman Catholic Primary School - Our Wraparound Care
pageCache.text:
Our Wraparound Care
Afterschool Club
Our After School Club
Dear Parents and Carers
Our After-school club runs every week day Mondays to Fridays. The cost for each session is £6:00. All sessions must be paid using a valid ParentPay account.
After-school club must be booked in advance using the booking form which can be found below.
We prefer not to accept children on an "ad hoc basis" as we need to make sure we have enough: staff, food or materials prepared for the number of children attending.
The children will receive a healthy snack and participate in a number of activities such as: art and crafts, construction, board games, cooking etc.
Any parent or carer who is consistently late for pick up will forfeit their place in the club and there will be no refund for fees paid.
For further information please contact the school office. office@st-simons-ashford.kcsp.org.uk
Peter McCabe Headteacher
Afterschool Club Booking
Afterschool Club Booking
Breakfast Club
Our Breakfast Club runs daily from 7:45a.m. The cost of the club is £3:00 per session and this must be paid for in advance using your “Parent Pay” account.
The children will receive a nutritional healthy breakfast and will be able to participate in a number of activities such as: board games, construction, reading etc.
Breakfast Club must be booked in advance using the booking form which can be found below. We prefer not to accept children on an "ad hoc basis" as we need to make sure we have enough food prepared for the number of children attending.
All children if possible should attend at 7:45a.m as one sitting for breakfast makes it easier for our staff to prepare.
We will finish serving breakfast at 8:15a.m as this allows the children time to finish breakfast before the official start of the school day.
Peter McCabe Headteacher

pageCache.text:
Safeguarding
At St Simon of England RC Primary School, the safety and well-being of our pupils is of paramount importance.The school takes the Safeguarding of children very seriously, if you have any concerns regarding a child’s welfare, please contact our safeguarding team using the contact information below or speak to one of the class teachers/adults who will arrange for you to speak to our safeguarding team.
If you are a member of staff, please use CPOMs to record your concerns and discuss these with either Mrs Bryant or Mrs Chambers your Designated Safeguarding Leads.
If you are a visitor or volunteer, with a concern please do not leave our site before speaking to a member of our team.
Concerned about a child
Contact the School’s Designated Child Protection Officers:Mrs H Bryant email: safeguarding@st-simons-ashford.kcsp.org.uk
Deputy Designated Child Protection Officer:Mrs F Chambers email: Fay.Chambers@st-simons-ashford.kcsp.org.uk
Telephone school: 01233 623199Or K.C.C Central Duty Team: 03000 41 11 11 Out of hours 03000 41 91 91
If you have a safeguarding concern you would like to raise with the trust, please email: safeguarding@kscp.org.uk
The Trust Director for Safeguarding is: Mr Julian Gizzi, Foundation Director.

pageCache.pageTitle: St Simon of England Roman Catholic Primary School - SEND
pageCache.text:
SEND
Welcome Message
'St Simon's mission is to work, learn, pray and play together to fulfil God's unique plan for each and every one of us'.
At St. Simon’s RC Primary School, we strive to ensure that every pupil progresses and we fully support all children to achieve their potential. Alongside Kent County Council guidelines, we strive to provide high quality teaching for all through the use of the Mainstream Core Standards. However, for some of our children additional support is needed in different areas:
There are 4 main areas of SEN:
* Communication and Interaction - this includes autistic pupils and those who may have speech and language needs.
* Cognition and Learning - this includes pupils with difficulties in their academic learning and those with dyslexia or dyscalculia.
* Social, Emotional and Mental Health - this includes pupils with emotional and behavioural needs and those diagnosed with ADHD.
* Physical and/or Sensory Needs - this includes pupils with hearing or visual impairment or those diagnosed with specific sensory processing difficulties.
At St. Simon's we support and celebrate all the diverse needs of our children. We are committed to providing a fully inclusive environment. We therefore aim to adapt our teaching and classrooms to ensuring that pupils can work alongside each other, supporting their own well-being and developing their respect for our whole community.
The SEN Lead is Mrs F. Chambers.
Mrs Chambers is available on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, through the school office.
